authorized_by: user instruction: Lets set up the local vm side
purpose: Reproduce the Azure Ubuntu 24.04 VPN backend guest environment locally and validate the exact TLS accept-loop deployment artifact, systemd unit, readiness checks, shallow TCP probe tolerance, and rollback behavior before any further Azure deployment.

target_parity.probe_model: raw TCP connections that send no TLS ClientHello

local_vm_scope.name: servicetracer-vpn-local
local_vm_scope.platform: Multipass preferred; any Ubuntu 24.04 VM is acceptable
local_vm_scope.network: NAT or host-only; no public exposure required

validation_contract: exact embedded backend source renders and compiles
systemd service becomes active and enabled
loopback HTTPS health returns the expected payload
private-IP HTTPS health returns the expected payload
twelve raw TCP probe connections do not starve a legitimate HTTPS request
listener queue remains below configured backlog
deployed file hashes equal rendered artifact hashes
named checkpoint failure records the exact boundary
forced local validation failure restores the previous backend and unit
failure_behavior: Stop locally, preserve logs and hashes, and do not authorize or trigger another Azure deployment from this harness.
